question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word in the given sentence.

Anthony Trollope was an __industrious__ and disciplined writer.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Lazy**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"industrious"** means someone who is diligent and hardworking; it refers to a person who puts in a lot of effort and is consistently productive. (परिश्रमी)

 
 
• **Example: **She is an industrious student who always completes her assignments on time.
 
 
 
• **"Lazy" **refers to someone who is unwilling to work or put in effort; it describes a person who prefers to avoid physical or mental exertion. (आलसी)
 
 
• **Example: **He is too lazy to clean his room, even when it gets very messy.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'industrious' **is **'lazy'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Lazy**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Exhausting** (थकाऊ): Causing one to feel very tired.

 
 
• **Example:** The long hike up the mountain was exhausting.
 
 
 
• **Dizzy** (चक्कर आना): Feeling as if everything is spinning around you and that you are not able to balance.
 
 
• **Example:** She felt dizzy after spinning around in circles.
 
 
 
• **Skittish** (चंचल): Easily frightened or excited.
 
 
• **Example:** The skittish horse bolted at the sound of the thunder.
